candidates.change_summary: Change block storage from block.number + 1 to block.number so that settle condition block.number > guesses block is reachable one block earlier.
Remove the require for msg.value == 1 ether, allowing free lock-in and changing contract balance flow.
Change condition to require guesses[msg.sender].block != 0, inverting the check and allowing multiple lock-ins or overwriting existing guess.
Delete the assignment to guesses[msg.sender].block, leaving it zero, which makes settle() always revert on the block != 0 check.
Replace guess assignment with a constant bytes32 zero, so any correct answer from keccak256 is unlikely to match.
Insert an early return after the first require, preventing guess and block storage from being set.
Replace the settlement payout amount from 2 ether to 1 ether.
Delete the require checking contract balance before transferring the payout, allowing settlement even if insufficient balance.
Delete the line that resets guesses[msg.sender].block to 0, allowing the same guess to be settled again.
Replace the blockhash used for answer with blockhash of the current block number instead of the guessed block.
Replace the condition so payout occurs when guess does NOT equal answer, inverting the logic.
Move the block reset before the answer computation so the guesser's block field is zero when computing answer.
Delete the second require that enforces block.number > guesses[msg.sender].block, allowing immediate settlement.
